label: Cinematic Orchestral Pop / Chinese Traditional Fusion

cards.mood: The piece opens with a solitary, mournful atmosphere that feels ancient and desolate.
cards.palette: A solo bamboo flute (Dizi) introduces the main melodic motif, setting the tonal color before being joined by a grand piano that provides the core harmonic structure from the first verse through to the outro.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Dust settles on the silent stone
Where the mountain meets the sky
A single lantern burns alone
As the ancient rivers sigh
[Pre-Chorus]
Petals fall in a rhythmic dance
Lost within a timeless trance
[Chorus]
Rise like the mist on the peak
Find the truth that the shadows speak
A thousand years in a single breath
Life blooming wide from the seeds of death
[Verse]
Silk threads weave a golden road
Beneath the moon's silver light
The willow bows, a heavy load
Folding the day into the night
[Pre-Chorus]
The wind whispers secrets of old
Stories of courage, brave and bold
[Chorus]
Rise like the mist on the peak
Find the truth that the shadows speak
A thousand years in a single breath
Life blooming wide from the seeds of death
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
Mountains stand as frozen guards
Painting the land in emerald shards
[Chorus]
Rise like the mist on the peak
Find the truth that the shadows speak
A thousand years in a single breath
Life blooming wide from the seeds of death
[Outro]
